Risk factors are not so clear so as follows

1.Pregnancy and the first few weeks after delivery2.Problems with blood clotting; for example, antiphospholipid syndrome, protein C and S deficiency, antithrombin III deficiency, lupus anticoagulant, or factor V Leiden mutation3.Cancer4.Collagen vascular diseases like lupus, Wegener’s granulomatosis,andBehcetsyndrome5.Obesity6.Low blood pressure in the brain (intracranial hypotension)7.Inflammatory bowel disease like Crohn’s disease or ulcerative colitis

https://61tejarshini.blogspot.com/2021/06/general-medicine-case-discussion.html?m=1 

👉 Case is well done, with all appropriate matter... 
Mentioned everything related to case history taking that is... Chief complaint, history of present illness, history of past illness, personal history, family history, general examination, systemic examination are done. Every thing is perfectly done along with inserting pictures of patient and reports of other investigations .Clear information about the treatment done each day until the patient discharged.
 
Patient came with the complaint of altered sensorium, he has shortness of breath, lethargy, anasarca. 
Before for neck pain and  lower back pain he has taken creatinine.
I have explained about creatinine action :-
💦Creatinine --Creatinine levels are usually an indication of normal muscle metabolism. It usually enters your blood after it is broken down. Your kidneys then remove it from your bloodstream before creatinine finally exits your body through urine. 
 
He used to have chronic kidney disease -treatment taken and hypertension -on medication some details about  it's actions:-  
💦T STAMALOBETA OD--Tablet is a combination  medicine that contains two active ingredients, Amlodipine and Atenolol Both of medicines in this combination work to lower blood pressure but in different ways. Together they help to relax the blood vessels, reduce the heart rate.

Finally ,he was in treatment in hospital 
Given ,I have know it's action as follows  
💦INJ.LASIX(40mg/IV/TID)-- A diuretic  . It helps your body get rid of extra water by increasing the amount of urine you make. Getting rid of extra water decreases the strain on your heart and blood vessels, thereby lowering high blood pressure  and reducing your risk of strokes, heart attacks and kidney problems. This effect can also improve symptoms such as trouble breathing  and edema.  

💦J.NaHCO3(100meq in100mlNS/IV/Stat)--this is the article about it... More information in it.. 
https://www.statpearls.com/articlelibrary/viewarticle/29196

💦T.NODOSIS 550mg/P.O/TID-- Tablet relieves irritation by producing carbon dioxide which neutralizes the acid present in the stomach. It also increases the pH of blood and urine, thereby correcting acid indigestion, heartburn. Additionally, it helps in the removal of toxic substances from the body in certain types of poisoning.
